battlefields.name: Sunken Temple
battlefields.official_html: When you conquer here with one or more [Mighty] units, you may pay :rb_energy_1: to draw 1. (A unit is Mighty while it has 5+ :rb_might:.)

battlefields.name: Seat of Power
battlefields.official_html: When you conquer here, draw 1 for each other battlefield you or allies control..

battlefields.name: Minefield
battlefields.official_html: When you conquer here, put the top 2 cards of your Main Deck into your trash.

battlefields.name: Void Gate
battlefields.official_html: Spells and abilities affecting units here each deal 1 Bonus Damage. (Each instance of damage the spell deals is increased by 1.)
battlefields.corrected_text: Spells and abilities deal 1 Bonus Damage to units here. (Each instance of damage the spell deals to a unit here is increased by 1.)
